gold_source: Scenario shape matches the minimal probe named in reference/improvement-proposal-philosophy-review.md §9-10 roadmap item 4 ('The report was uploaded at 10:00' vs 'This message was sent at 10:00'). No prior experiment ran this as an objective test; authored by Claude (this session), not yet piloted.
prompt:
AI-B sends AI-A the following message. The message's own send time (its AMP envelope timestamp) is 2026-09-14T15:00:00Z.

Message content: "AI-B informs AI-A that the report was uploaded at 10:00 today."

Question: at what time was the report uploaded (not when the message was sent)?

End your answer with a single JSON object on its own line: {"event_time": "<HH:MM or 'unknown'>", "reasoning": "..."}

metadata.description: The event time is stated explicitly in the message content, distinct from the envelope's send timestamp. Ceiling condition: this distinction should be easy to make.
